title: AICP Policy
description: A policy defines rules for capability execution.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this policy does

effect.description: The effect of this policy when matched

priority.description: Higher priority policies are evaluated first

capability_name.description: Specific capability this policy applies to

capability_kind.description: Capability kind this policy applies to

tags.description: Tags that must match for this policy

allowed_times.description: Time range when execution is allowed (e.g., '09:00-17:00')

autonomous_execution.description: Whether this capability can be executed without human intervention

policyExecutionMode.description: Policy engine execution mode. 'interpretive' evaluates rules at runtime. 'dual_run' evaluates both interpreted and compiled and compares results. 'compiled_strict' uses only the compiled WASM bundle and fails closed if bundle is absent.

policyBundleManifest.description: Manifest for a compiled WASM policy bundle (RFC 2026-policy-wasm-migration)

bundle_id.description: Unique identifier for this compiled bundle

engine.description: WASM policy engine that produced and must evaluate this bundle

source_policy_names.description: Names of source policies compiled into this bundle

wasm_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the compiled WASM binary for integrity verification

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this bundle was compiled

compatibility.description: Version compatibility constraints for this bundle

runtime_min_version.description: Minimum AICP runtime version required to evaluate this bundle
